[LSCP.3.4] Capture facts per [LCCO.5.2] are engine-named uses
of the same activation-scoped lifecycle. The compiler
synthesises `$CaptureBindings_<rule>_c<N>` facts that the
runtime asserts and retracts on the same completion paths it
tracks for an author-emitted `scope activation` fact. Both share
runtime bookkeeping; only the fact-naming differs.
